our_title: 635741dd removed metisf_h: both MeTiS libraries now generate metisf.h concurrently
ran: Pristine 7.0.18 CMake tree (cm/base32): 'Generating metisf.h' rule in scotchmetisv3.dir and scotchmetisv5.dir build.make; 10 x (rm src/include/metis.h metisf.h; make -j3): metisf.h generated twice in 4/10 runs (cm/race-base-all.log). In 7.0.17 both libraries depended on the metisf_h target, which generated it once. With patch 0007: once in 10/10 (cm/race-patched-all.log).
evidence: libscotchmetis/CMakeLists.txt:62 'add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${GENERATED_INCLUDE_DIR}/metisf.h' and :85 '${GENERATED_INCLUDE_DIR}/metisf.h)' in add_library(scotchmetisv${version} ...) for 3 and 5; 635741dd deleted 'add_custom_target(metisf_h ...)' and 'add_dependencies(scotchmetisv${version} scotch_h metisf_h)'.

fix_options.label: a: drive metis.h and metisf.h by one metis_h custom target (with BLD-12)
fix_options.tested: race loop 10 x -> once each; ctest 172/172 (32/64)

upstream_fix_review.details: Introduced by 635741dd: removing metisf_h left metisf.h with two independent owners (libscotchmetis/CMakeLists.txt:85 in foreach 3 5); see BLD-12.
upstream_fix_review.compared_with_ours: Fixed by our rewritten BLD-12 commit.
